disputes.reason: Setup defines a risk budget as a 'share' of diversified fund VaR, so the four shares sum to 100%, yet the options compare the sum to EUR 22.10m; the unit is incoherent and the setup never says budgets are in EUR (the bank defines them as the EUR amount of fund VaR). A careful candidate could defend 'exactly 100%' and find none of the options fits. The round also reduces to a definitional trivia item.
